dispute.claim_text: Woodlands to one-north is 24 km on the BKE and the PIE, I do it four mornings a week and it is never more than $32. Today he came off at Bukit Panjang and went down Upper Bukit Timah and around by the AYE. 30 km and $37.74. He said something about a closure but I did not see any closure.

counterparty_statement.text: PIE towards Tuas was shut after Clementi Road, lorry fire, LTA put out an advisory at 7.10am. I came off at Bukit Panjang and used Upper Bukit Timah and the AYE. It is the only lawful way round and it cost me time too.

admissibility.notes: Trip record complete and causally ordered.

payload.optimal_route_source: routing-engine-v3.2 (LTA traffic snapshot 07:44; optimal is BKE southbound then PIE westbound, no gantry at this hour)

admissibility.notes: Unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage, with speed varying by road class and junction dwells at zero. Shows the exit at Bukit Panjang before the closed segment and the rejoin on the AYE.
Driver announced the closure before diverting; the rider replied without objecting.

messages.text: boss PIE towards tuas closed, lorry fire. i come off at bukit panjang ok
as long as i reach by 8.30

admissibility.notes: Line items reconcile to the cent. tolls_erp is 0.00 and erp_gantries is empty: neither route crosses a gantry at this hour, so POL-RD-09 has nothing to settle and the exoneration is total.
